sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.text_preview: R ADIO-FREQUENCY (RF) integrated circuits in CMOS are developing a strong presence in the commercial world. sections.title: COMMERCIALIZATION
sections.text_preview: Bipolar RF ICs dominated in cellular mobile handsets for many years, because there was little incentive, and mainly risk, in switching to CMOS. The spur for commercialization of CMOS wireless transceivers came with new markets for Bluetooth and the IEEE 802.11 WLANs, whose economics were entirely different than those of cellular handsets.
